text: there's no such thing as being too mean to a man if you think you're being mean you probably could be meaner men are not nice people they're not innately nice they're not running around trying to see how they can be nice to other people and if they're around you or they're doing something it is because they are benefiting from it they always put themselves first so you need to be being mean to get out of that what you want out of that so apparently there is no such thing as being too mean to a man all right imagine for a second if a guy said the same thing about women that probably wouldn't turn out so well but let's be real this is exactly the kind of mindset that ruins modern dating you don't build connection through hostility you don't win in relationships by treating people like enemies and this idea that men are not nice people come on many men i know are breaking their backs at work providing helping family and trying to be just decent human beings if you expect everyone to be manipulative you'll only attract manipulative people if you treat everyone like they're the enemy don't be surprised when real men stop approaching you altogether guys don't ever chase women like that when someone openly says be mean to men she is literally disqualifying herself from being taken seriously she's telling you she's angry bitter and stuck in a mindset where relationships are a power struggle so do yourself a favor be kind but to the right people and when you meet someone like this smile not and walk away let her keep being mean by herself
